premises.text: Fish farms need frequent underwater inspection of nets and mooring lines, but commercial divers are expensive, imprecise, and leave paper notes that must be transcribed for regulators
premises.evidence_span: farm managers only have one solution, which is commercially trained divers

premises.text: An intuitive, portable underwater robot with replaceable thrusters, gimbal camera, and current-holding capability can perform aquaculture inspections at a fraction of existing solution cost
premises.evidence_span: an underwater robot that is very intuitive to pilot

premises.text: An app and cloud service structure inspection tasks, store photos/video/comments, and let managers review data and file regulatory reports with one click
premises.evidence_span: upload the entire inspection data to our cloud-based service

premises.text: Product line spans Explorer hardware, Inspector with subscription service, and a Developer research SKU, with expansion beyond aquaculture to other underwater inspection markets
premises.evidence_span: we have our C-Drone Explorer, which is the basic model

value.text: Safer, more efficient underwater inspections with better data for farm managers
value.evidence_span: make fish farming both safer and more efficient all at once

causal_links.evidence_span: maintaining and inspecting a farm is extremely challenging
professional subsea robots to automate underwater inspections
the farm manager can easily make a better decision

notes: Escape risk, diver cost/pairs, paper notes, and transcription folded as one aquaculture inspection pain-bundle (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). Robot weight/thrusters/gimbal/current-holding treated as feature cascade of one ROV mechanism (§4.1.7). App tasking and cloud reporting kept as a separately revisable software module demoed independently. Adjacent underboat/oil-gas/dam markets folded with SKU lineup as GTM breadth. Singleton domains retained as separately learnable modules.
